searchText: Arrow Glacier is coming soon! It is expected for Thursday, Dec 9th (https://ethernodes.org/arrow_glacier). If you haven't yet, upgrade your nodes 😄 Full list of compatible client versions available here: https://blog.ethereum.org/2021/11/10/arrow-glacier-announcement/
